CREATE TABLE `employees` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
	`totalCommercialContracts` int DEFAULT 0,
	`totalResidentialContracts` int DEFAULT 0,
	`totalRegisteredContracts` int DEFAULT 0,
	`totalPendingContracts` int DEFAULT 0,
	`totalReviewedContracts` int DEFAULT 0,
	`totalDocumentationFees` decimal(15,2) DEFAULT '0',
	`totalBrokerageFees` decimal(15,2) DEFAULT '0',
	`totalContractAmounts` decimal(15,2) DEFAULT '0',
	`totalRegions` int DEFAULT 0,
	`totalCities` int DEFAULT 0,
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	`updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	CONSTRAINT `employees_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
